## Haines et al. (2001), BM3

`molybenum_carbide_mo2c_haines_2001_bm3_1` · Executable

Reproduction: **close** · [Reconstruction report](../reconstruction-reports/molybenum_carbide_mo2c.md#record-molybenum_carbide_mo2c_haines_2001_bm3_1)

**Source finding:** The experimental EOS is fitted to relative volume. The measured ambient hexagonal subcell was converted to the equivalent four-formula-unit orthorhombic conventional-cell volume used by the record.

Automatic selection for equilibrium calculations.

| Component | Parameter | Value | Reported error | Fixed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primary | V0 | 148.9071 | 0.049 | Yes |
| Primary | K0 | 307.0 | 5.0 | Not listed |
| Primary | K0\_prime | 6.2 | 0.3 | Not listed |

- **Origin of the parameterization:** experimental
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Haines; Léger; Chateau; Lowther
    - **Year:** 2001
    - **Title:** Experimental and theoretical investigation of Mo2C at high pressure
    - **Source:** J. Phys.: Condens. Matter
    - **Volume:** 13
    - **Locator:** 2447-2454
    - **DOI:** 10.1088/0953-8984/13/11/303
- **Reference temperature (K):** 300.0
- **Reported pressure coverage (GPa):** \[0.0, 46.0\]

Room-temperature BM3 fit to relative-volume (V/V0) X-ray data; the paper does not report V0 as a fitted coefficient. The stored V0 is computed from the sample's measured ambient hexagonal subcell, a = 3.0128(4) Å and c = 4.7357(9) Å, converted to the four-formula-unit orthorhombic cell, with its error propagated from the lattice-parameter errors.

## Peritheos refit of Haines et al. (2001), digitized-data BM3

`molybenum_carbide_mo2c_haines_2001_bm3_refit` · Executable

Reproduction: **reproduced** · [Reconstruction report](../reconstruction-reports/molybenum_carbide_mo2c.md#record-molybenum_carbide_mo2c_haines_2001_bm3_refit)

**Source finding:** The source plots 16 relative-volume observations and identifies a BM3 curve with K0=307 GPa and K0'=6.2. This separate record is the reproducible Peritheos errors-in-variables fit to all digitized marker centers with measured V0 fixed; it is not presented as a published coefficient set.

Peritheos BM3 refit of the points digitized from Figure 2 of Haines et al. (2001), not a published parameter set. V0 is fixed at the measured ambient volume used for the source's V/V0 data; K0 and K0' are fitted with errors in both digitized pressure and relative volume.
